Maktoum bin Mohammed: Today, I met with Georges Elhedery, Group CEO of HSBC, and discussed opportunities to strengthen cooperation in banking, finance and investment. Dubai and HSBC share a longstanding relationship spanning decades, during which the Group’s banking operations have contributed to the growth of the financial services sector. We remain committed to building strategic partnerships with leading global banking and financial institutions to support economic development in the UAE and Dubai. Our partnerships remain strong, our approach steadfast, our vision clear, and our steps bold as we move towards a prosperous future for the UAE.

Maktoum bin Mohammed meets with Georges Elhedery, Group CEO of HSBC. The meeting reviewed the longstanding relationship between the UAE and HSBC and explored opportunities to strengthen cooperation in banking, finance and investment. Discussions also highlighted Dubai’s growing role as a global financial hub, supported by its advanced infrastructure and regulatory environment, and its ability to attract international financial institutions, investment and highly skilled talent from around the world.

Emirates NBD and BlackRock launch two new income-focused funds, the FundStar Emirates CLO AA Fund and the Emirates Systematic Income and Growth Fund to mark the first anniversary of their partnership. Building on the initial investment platform launched by the two parties in 2025 to give the bank’s high-net-worth clients access to alternative investments, the partnership has attracted USD 350 million in assets under management. The new funds address growing investor demand for regular income, capital preservation and portfolio diversification.
